description:
> Hello! We are Team MARATHA from India. We are building a Health Monitoring Software for Astronauts on Space .

*TITLE:*

> ASTRA-HEALTH - AI Health Monitoring for Astronauts

*SUMMARY:

> In space, there is no doctor. ASTRA-HEALTH monitors Heart Rate, Oxygen, Radiation and Sleep of astronauts in real-time and gives instant AI Doctor advice. It gives Red Alert before health becomes critical, to save lives on Moon and Mars
